C.C.No.11827/2024
 06th day of August 2025
 Complainant: State by - Byatarayanapura Police Station
 (By A.P.P.)

V/s  Accused:
 1. Mohammed Rizwan  S/o. Shuban Sharif, A/a 39 years  R/o. No.8/1, 6th main  11th Cross, Bapuji Nagar  Mysore Road  Bengaluru.
 (By Sri. Eashwar Prasad.B., Advocate)
 JUDGMENT
This is a charge sheet filed by Byatarayanapura Police station against the accused for the offence punishable Under Sections 498(A), 324, 504, 506 of IPC.
. The case of the prosecution in brief is that, the marriage of the accused solemnized on 25.09.2016 at Bengaluru as per their customs.
After the marriage the accused and complainant were residing at Bapuji Nagara, 6th main, Bengaluru.
Thereafter, the accused without any reason everyday used to quarrel with the complainant by demanding money.
The accused used subjected her physical and mental cruelty.
On 25.11.2023 at about 9.30 pm, the accused abused the complainant with filthy language, assaulted by belts and mobile charges and gave life threat.
On the basis of the complaint given by the Cw.1, the Cw.7 registered a case in Cr.No.464/2023.
Thereafter the Cw.7 having completed the investigation filed charge sheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.

The Pw.1 did not lodged any complaint against the accused.

Hence, in view of fact that, the Pw.1 herself turned completely hostile to the case of prosecution, the prayer of learned APP to issue summons to remaining witnesses was rejected as no purpose would have been served by examining the remaining witnesses.
The Ld.
APP treated the prosecution witness as hostile witness and cross-examined.
In the cross-examination also the Pw.1 did not chose to support the case of the prosecution and deposed the evidence in consonance with the C.C.No.11827/2024 chief examination.
The Pw.1 during the course of cross examination as clearly admitted that the matter was settled between the parties.
Therefore, prosecution has failed to prove the guilty of the accused beyond all reasonable doubt.

Accordingly, I answer point No.1 to 4 in the Negative and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
Exercising the power under section 248 (1) of Cr.P.C. the accused is acquitted for the offences punishable Under Section 498(A), 324, 504 & 506 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bonds stand cancelled.
